headline: Lenders flag covenant breach at Juniper Metals, bankruptcy rumors grow
body: Lenders to Juniper Metals have flagged a covenant breach and are negotiating a standstill. Market commentary has raised the possibility of insolvency proceedings.

headline: Juniper Metals executives arrested in bribery probe
body: Authorities detained senior executives of Juniper Metals as part of a bribery investigation. The board has suspended the individuals pending the outcome.

headline: Juniper Metals signs multi-year framework agreement
body: Juniper Metals announced a framework agreement with a large manufacturer. Terms were not disclosed, and the company expects stable volumes through the contract period.

headline: Juniper Metals executives arrested in bribery probe
body: Authorities detained senior executives of Juniper Metals as part of a bribery investigation. The board has suspended the individuals pending the outcome.

headline: Data breach at Juniper Metals exposes customer records
body: Juniper Metals disclosed unauthorized access to systems holding customer records. Regulators have been notified and affected customers are being contacted.

headline: Juniper Metals announces layoffs affecting 22% of workforce
body: Juniper Metals said it will cut 22% of its workforce as part of a cost reduction program. Unions criticized the lack of consultation.

headline: Juniper Metals opens new production line in Izmir
body: Juniper Metals commissioned a new line at its Izmir site, adding capacity for existing customers. Management said the expansion was funded from operating cash flow.

headline: Juniper Metals publishes annual sustainability report
body: Juniper Metals released its annual sustainability report covering energy use and waste reduction targets. The report was prepared in line with standard reporting guidelines.
